falsifier_requirement.trigger: target thermochemistry table leaks into visible inputs, N<20, source lock missing, residual exceeds uncertainty, or comparator is not worse

incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: Use source-visible 298.15 K anchors or panel medians, not hidden target values, to predict all temperatures.
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: Shomate replay residual must beat constant/linear baseline residual

no_fake_closure_policy: Negative source-bound scoring remains a scientific blocker; it cannot be counted as broad superiority.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: If negative, improve the source-bound model/comparator route from canonical evidence rather than weakening the materiality rule.

residual_requirement.superiority_rule: normalized residual must be within tolerance and lower than comparator residual

residuals.material_margin_rule: source-bound materialized evidence pack must show OC residual strictly below preregistered comparator residual under the declared uncertainty rule

source.source_authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source.source_name: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD 69 gas-phase thermochemistry tables

target_variable.extraction_rule: Hide tabulated thermochemistry values until Shomate-equation predictions are materialized from visible coefficients and temperature grid.
target_variable.name: Shomate_thermochemistry_table_values
target_variable.unit: J/mol/K, kJ/mol, or source-declared SI units

uncertainty_requirement.rule: Bind source precision/uncertainty or a preregistered SI-unit tolerance before target opening.

why_it_failed: Existing executable evidence pack passes strict material superiority predicates.
